source_split_note: TSB-AD-U is presented for unsupervised anomaly scoring, and its published Tuning/Eva lists are lists of series, not supervised window train/validation/test partitions. Across all 870 CSVs, 177 filename-declared training prefixes contain positive labels; the other 693 are normal-only. Thus supervised reinterpretation is structurally possible for a subset, but the published split does not supply a supervised protocol. First-positive filename metadata mismatches one WSD file, which has an earlier positive label at row 4272 than the encoded value 11822.
task_disposition: CROSS OUT TSB-AD-U as an admitted supervised benchmark in this suite. Numeric causal windows are compatible, direct public ZIP download is verified, and 177 series contain positive labels in their filename-declared training prefix. However, the canonical Tuning/Eva lists are not supervised train/validation/test windows; 693 series have no positive labels in their training prefix; most source groups lack stated open reuse licenses; and no candidate-family MLP pilot establishes non-saturation. Potentially researchable licensed subsets are TODS (Apache-2.0, 13/15 training prefixes positive) and LTDB (ODC Attribution 1.0, 5/9), but the official series split gives too few supervised tuning examples for a stable direct-comparison suite. These remain crossed out until a leakage-safe split and empirical MLP difficulty screen are demonstrated.

verified_split_scan.method: Each CSV label sequence was parsed fully in the initial archive pass. A second scan counted all positives inside each filename-declared training prefix and found the first positive for comparison to the filename metadata.

memory_unit_note: Per-series estimates treat each CSV as one model task, use 128-sample windows over the filename-declared training prefix, float32 flattened inputs and five 512-unit hidden layers. They count the full input matrix plus five forward activation tensors only; backward/autograd, optimizer states, parameters and CUDA workspace are excluded. Source-group aggregate activation estimates assume pooling all member prefixes and are not per-series requirements.

full_schema_validation.binary_label_validation: all files contain only integer-valued labels 0 and 1

repo_architecture_compatibility.architecture: src/simple_adp/models.py::TabularMLP accepts a configurable input_dim and any positive hidden-width vector; a univariate series window maps to 128 inputs, and multivariate width maps to 128 times the channel count.
repo_architecture_compatibility.task_adapter: src/simple_adp/advanced_tasks.py::SupervisedAnomalyTask is a binary classifier, but fit_targets rejects a training partition without both labels. A per-point binary label can be supervised as center/next-point window classification after a causal fixed-window transform.
repo_architecture_compatibility.runner_integration: No TSB-AD-U/M dataset provider or validated task configuration is registered in the repo.
repo_architecture_compatibility.split_safety: Use the filename-declared temporal training prefix only for training/validation, keep the suffix as chronological test, and exclude a window gap at the partition boundary; random overlapping-window splits leak adjacent samples.
